capabilities: Create freeform canvas boards with cards, connections, group frames and nested boards
Organise notes, folders and boards as customisable icon or cover-image tiles in grid mode
Track projects with kanban boards, typed tables, checklists and due dates
Draw with pressure-sensitive pen and highlighter tools, including scene-by-scene storyboards
Collaborate on a shared board over a private network with live cursors and edits
disambiguation: Not a sketchnoting or image-annotation tool; it provides board layouts and organisational tools on top of Obsidian's Canvas format.
extras: Experimental collaboration is opt-in, requires Obsidian 1.11.4+ and a private network the user controls (e.g. Tailscale, ZeroTier); it has no cloud or accounts. The author discloses the plugin is built with heavy AI assistance (Claude) and runs a 900+ test suite. Boards are spec-compliant .canvas files that open in native Canvas without the plugin.
intentEvidence: Visual Notes began as a fork of Icon Board by RK-Media, used under the MIT licence.
problem: Obsidian's native Canvas offers freeform cards and connections but lacks planning structures such as kanban columns, typed tables, tile grids, drawing tools and templates.

relations.evidence: Visual Notes began as a fork of Icon Board by RK-Media, used under the MIT licence.

summary: Visual workspace built on Obsidian's .canvas format with nested boards, icon-tile grids, kanban boards, tables, sticky notes, drawing and storyboards.
